notes.title: The Cyber Masquerade Release
notes.notes:
I might as well been on my goddamn knees begging for this game to be released for the past few months, and voila, finally, it's out. 

I swear there is this one dude or dudette out for my ass or something because I've seen a couple of games that is obviously AI came out during the period when the AI guidelines weren't clear. Or mine is just too obvious, who knows, they never made it clear. Doesn't matter now, it's finally out. 

In case anyone didn't realize the AI art disclaimer is just below the descriptions. 

The AI guideline is a new thing, before this, there isn't any disclaimers for that. So for that, I am grateful to whoever that finally made the changes and clarification on the Steam AI guidelines. 

The depot glitched tf out and somehow all 3 of the goddamn files got meshed together in a single download, I am going to get around fixing it soon or maybe not. 

I must hate money or something, I had the idea of just doing hentai straight-up then go on Patreon to make banks doing episodic hentai, but I thought I wasn't broke enough so I went out on a limb and wrote  a romance instead. 

There is very little sexual content in this game but I couldn't release the game if I didn't mark it as frequent sexual content. Steam QA wanted me to include in for whatever reason even though clearly, there was only some.

It's a romance visual novel with no choices. Kinetic visual novel. If you are looking to only fap, unfortunately you might need to look elsewhere.

The story is about a guy realizing he's living in a dystopia with his robot gf. He's kind of brain-washed so he doesn't really know he's living in a dystopia. 

It's about 3 hours long if you set it on autoplay. 

Enjoy the story. 

EDIT:
I was hoping to get episode 1.5 drawn with real art but I overestimated my budget, hence it's still AI art, I will release it soon but it will cost you some cash money, if you like episode 1 and would like to support me, you can purchase 1.5 when it comes out. (There is a sex scene in there). But it is only about 30 minutes long. 

Anyway my app credit got refunded twice, the two times my app got retired, lol, I reused this 100 USD twice, it really is true third time is the charm.
